MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a natural next purchase because it would let my existing Echo devices control a lamp, adding something useful to the setup I already have.",
    "The Blink bundle connects my earlier interest in home security with my current Alexa devices, so it offers a plausible way to expand what I can do at home."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks duplicate the role of my recently purchased Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle, and the older Echo Dot gives me little reason to buy after getting a fourth-generation Dot.",
    "A larger Echo Show interests me, but my recent Show 5 and stand make another display hard to justify right now.",
    "Using Alexa at home does not give me a clear need for Alexa in my car, and neither earbuds nor a tablet answers a need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "My streaming purchase seems to have prompted more streaming devices, although that purchase already filled the need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I recently bought matters: my newer Dot, Show 5, and 4K Max make overlapping or older devices less useful to me now.",
    "My Show stand and replacement remote batteries suggest that I also look for ways to support equipment I already own; a useful addition can matter more than another main device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in an Alexa-connected home, but missed that I currently value useful additions more than devices that repeat functions I already have."
}
